subject.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads

question: Is the real Worker payload-reduction and exact-remapping proof sufficient to land this scoped mitigation despite the unbounded history-prune path and missing seconds/RSS benchmark?
rationale: The implementation has no concrete correctness finding, but deciding whether the demonstrated scope and performance evidence are enough requires ownership judgment over compaction reliability and the residual failure mode.

options.title: Land scoped mitigation
options.body: Accept the proven summary-planning reduction now and track bounded history-prune planning plus direct timing/RSS evidence separately.

options.title: Require complete performance proof
options.body: Hold merge until a representative 5-10 MB compaction scenario records before/after elapsed time and RSS and the history-prune exposure is either bounded or explicitly isolated.

recommendation.title: Land scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Accept the proven summary-planning reduction now and track bounded history-prune planning plus direct timing/RSS evidence separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the worker-backed compaction planning architecture and is best positioned to judge whether its remaining full-fidelity operation is acceptable.
